title: Cure depth of a photopolymer resin against the dose of light, each dose double the last
description: Bar chart of the depth to which a layer of resin sets for doses of 12.6, 25, 50, 100 and 200 millijoules per square centimetre: 37, 73, 110, 146 and 183 micrometres. Each doubling of the dose adds the same 37 micrometres. Worked from Jacobs's working curve, cure depth = Dp × ln(E ÷ Ec), with Dp = 53 µm and Ec = 6.3 mJ/cm², the values NIST measured for the resin PR48 at 405 nm (Bennett, 2017).
heading: CURE DEPTH, µm · DOSE DOUBLING EACH BAR
